display.name: Linux
display.description: Migrated from OpenTelemetry demo 33bd823107b1b38eaa88dd4ef625cc16d60475d4. All queries use ClickHouse. Metrics preserve PromQL calculations through ClickHouse SQL; other signals read Collector tables.

spec.query:
SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT tags['k8s_cluster_name'] AS value FROM timeSeriesTags(demo_metrics) WHERE metric_name = 'otelcol_process_uptime'
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT tags['k8s_node_name'] AS value FROM timeSeriesTags(demo_metrics) WHERE metric_name = 'otelcol_process_uptime' AND match(tags['k8s_cluster_name'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${k8s_cluster_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${k8s_cluster_name:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$'))
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT tags['host_name'] AS value FROM timeSeriesTags(demo_metrics) WHERE metric_name = 'otelcol_process_uptime_seconds_total'
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

display.name: Host Metadata
display.description: Host and OS metadata from resourcedetection processor

spec.query:
WITH if(has([${host_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${host_name:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_host_name
SELECT timestamp AS time, if(isFinite(value), value, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQuery(demo_metrics, concat('target_info{service_name="otelcol-contrib", host_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_host_name), '}'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'))
